$comment: Owner decisions, 2026-08-12. These supersede anything printed on the marketing graphics. Every value here becomes an editable row in admin — nothing below is hard-coded into pricing logic.

calendars.$decision: Casita and Gazebo have SEPARATE calendars. One group in the Casita does not block the Gazebo. Two groups can be on site at once.
calendars.$note: Both units use the same three check-in windows.

custom.$note: Owner sets in/out per booking when a guest needs different hours.

schedule.$turnover: Bookings are stored as real timestamps, so a night tour ending 06:00 and a day tour starting 07:00 do not collide on their own. turnoverMinutes adds a cleaning buffer on top. Default 60 — confirm.

deposit.$decision: 30% of the total secures the date. Once paid it cannot be cancelled, but the guest may move the date.

guests.$freeRule: 3 years old and below stay free.
guests.$extraRule: Guests aged 4 and above beyond the rate band's included count pay ₱300 each.

extension.condition: Only offered when no other booking follows on that unit.
extension.$systemNote: The booking engine can enforce this: an extension is offerable only if extending the checkout timestamp still clears the next booking plus turnover.
extension.$unconfirmed: Read as a per-hour rate. Confirm — it could be a flat fee per extension.

addOns.name: Firewood for the bonfire
addOns.$note: Use of the bonfire itself is free. The ₱250 is for the wood.

addOns.name: More than 3 pets
addOns.$unconfirmed: Read as a flat surcharge for bringing more than 3 pets. Confirm — it could be ₱400 per additional pet.

$addOnNote: The casita amenity card prints gas stove at ₱300/10hrs and ₱600/21hrs. The owner's current numbers are ₱250 and ₱500. The card is stale.

pets.$rule: Up to 3 pets at no charge. More than 3 is chargeable. Pets are not allowed in the pool.

fees.$decision: No corkage. No security deposit. No other charges beyond the add-ons listed above.

seasonalPricing.$decision: No weekend, holiday or peak rates today. The admin tab exists and is empty, so rates can be added later without a code change.

security.$copy: The farm is gated, CCTV is installed across the property, and caretakers are on site throughout your stay.

damages.$rule: Guests pay for any damage to the property.

$ownerStated.$FLAG: Owner wrote 'till 2pm'. Taken literally this bans videoke for the whole night tour (20:00–06:00), and their own Facebook copy advertises 24/7 karaoke. Almost certainly 2:00 AM. Built as an editable setting defaulting to 02:00 — NEEDS CONFIRMATION.

$ownerStated.rule: Guests pay for any damage to the property

$drafted.rule: Your booking is exclusive. Only the guests on your reservation may enter the unit you booked.
The pool is open for the full length of your booking. Children in the pool must have an adult with them.
No glass bottles inside or around the pool.
Up to 3 pets stay free. Pets are not allowed in the pool. Please clean up after them.
Bring your own food and drinks. There is no corkage.
Smoking is outdoors only, never inside the rooms.
Bonfires are lit and put out by the caretaker. Please don't leave one burning.
Park inside the gate. The last stretch of road is rough but passable for cars and vans.
Please check out on time so the caretakers can prepare for the next guests. Extra hours are available if nobody is booked after you.
Sound carries across the farm. Please keep music at a neighbourly level after the videoke curfew.

houseRules.$note: The drafted rules are proposals written from what the assets and the owner's answers already imply. Each one marked $confirm is a genuine guess and should be approved or cut before launch.

flow: Guest picks unit, date and check-in method.
Live price breakdown, including the 30% due now.
Guest pays or uploads proof of payment.
Booking is written to that unit's calendar.
An emailed receipt goes to the guest with every detail they entered; the owner is notified.
receiptIncludes: Check-in method with exact date and time
Number of guests and how many are under 4
Amount paid and balance due on arrival
Contact number for the unit booked
